summary:
CEILING VENTS TO BUY: 31 total (28 supply diffusers + 3 return grilles). All are Price, all white face.

Ceiling supply diffusers - Price SCD, louvered-face square 4-cone steel diffuser, white, 4-way throw, in a 24"x24" lay-in ceiling panel, factory-insulated backpan, NC 35 max, with a Price VCR9 radial balancing damper in the neck (M601 notes 1, 5, 7, 8, 12):
  - Tag A, 6" round neck - 5 ea (75/75/75/90/130 CFM)
  - Tag B, 8" round neck - 4 ea (150/150/140/140)
  - Tag C, 10" round neck - 15 ea (4 @250, 2 @200, 2 @300, 3 @350, 4 @375)
  - Tag D, 12" round neck - 1 ea (500)
  Subtotal 25 ea, 6,075 CFM.

Ceiling supply diffusers - Price SMD, louvered-face HIGH-CAPACITY steel diffuser, white, 4-way, 12"x12" face with 8" round neck, FLANGED FRAME for surface mounting (hard ceiling, not lay-in), with opposed-blade damper (notes 2, 4, 6, 7):
  - Tag J - 3 ea (175/150/150). Subtotal 475 CFM.

Ceiling return/exhaust grilles - Price 80, all-aluminum 1/2"x1/2"x1/2" egg crate, white, 24"x24" CORE-ONLY panel for a 24x24 lay-in grid (notes 3, 5, 7, 9):
  - Tag F - 3 ea. No CFM scheduled (balanced by system). M101 keynote 4: build a new 24x24 lined (1/2" liner) plenum on top of each and tap the existing 15x12 duct into it - the plenum is sheet-metal work, not a purchase item.

Ceiling total: 28 supply + 3 return = 31 devices, 6,550 CFM of ceiling supply.

DO NOT ORDER separately (already in the ceiling, but they come with the fans): 3 exhaust grilles shown on M101 with a dash instead of a tag letter (450, 450, 75 CFM). Those are the integral grilles furnished with Greenheck ceiling exhaust fans EF-1 and EF-2 (SPA-700, 450 CFM ea) and EF-3 (SP-B90, 75 CFM) - see EF schedule note 1 on M601. EF-1/EF-2 also get a factory grille-mounted motion sensor.

NOT CEILING - 15 more air devices are WALL mounted, so keep them off the ceiling order:
  - Tag E - 4 ea Price 95 return grille, approx. 30x18, primecoat (M101 keynote 7: engineer could not field-measure; FIELD VERIFY exact size before ordering)
  - Tag G - 4 ea Price 95 transfer grille, 36x36, mounted top el. 14'-8" AFF in MP Room 112 (M101 keynote 3; confirmed as "SIDEWALL TRANSFER GRILLE" on interior elevation A5-2)
  - Tag H - 3 ea Price 520D double-deflection supply grille, 18x8, 550 CFM ea, bottom el. 11'-11" AFF (keynote 5)
  - Tag I - 4 ea Price 520D double-deflection supply grille, 14x8, 450 CFM ea (FIELD VERIFY size)
  All four of these are primecoat finish and receive 2 coats of field paint - verify color with the architect (note 13).

ONE MORE ITEM, not a hexagon tag: M101 keynote 19 calls for 1 ea 14"x14" egg crate, Price model 82, mounted in the soffit with an insect screen on the back, at the outside-air intake.

Cross-checks and cautions:
  - 49 device tag hexagons were found on M101; 46 are scheduled tags and 3 are the fan-integral grilles. MD101 (demolition) has zero tags, so nothing is salvaged and reused - everything above is new purchase.
  - Total scheduled supply air comes to exactly 10,000 CFM (6,550 ceiling + 3,450 sidewall), which confirms the tag count.
  - Sizes with an asterisk in the schedule (tags E and I) carry the footnote "FIELD VERIFY EXACT GRILLE DIMENSION PRIOR TO ORDERING."
  - All devices: NC not to exceed 35 (note 7).
  - M601 general note 3: coordinate ceiling register locations with lighting, sprinkler heads and grid - see reflected ceiling plan A6-1 before you set the order.

Sheets used: M601 (Mechanical Legend, Schedules & General Notes - grille, exhaust fan and equipment schedules and their notes), M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan - device tag count, CFMs and keynotes), MD101 (Mechanical Demolition Floor Plan - confirms no reuse), A6-1 (Reflected Ceiling Plan - ceiling types and diffuser/register legend), A5-2 (Interior Elevations - confirms the 36x36 units are sidewall transfer grilles).
